description: This file defines interfaces for system information and subsystem management within the WPEFramework PluginHost namespace. It includes interface definitions for metadata, subsystem status, security, internet, location, identification, time, provisioning, and decryption, along with associated notifications and enumerations.
external_files: assuming Core::IUnknown is declared in core/IUnknown.h or similar

classes.name: IMetadata
classes.description: Interface providing access to system metadata such as build hash and version numbers.

classes.name: ISubSystem
classes.description: Interface for managing and querying various system subsystems and their statuses, including notifications and detailed subsystem interfaces.

classes.name: ISubSystem::INotification
classes.description: Notification interface for subsystem status changes.

classes.name: ISubSystem::ISecurity
classes.description: Interface for security subsystem details, including callsign information.

classes.name: ISubSystem::IInternet
classes.description: Interface for internet connectivity details, including IP address and network type.

classes.name: ISubSystem::ILocation
classes.description: Interface providing location details such as timezone, country, region, city, latitude, and longitude.

classes.name: ISubSystem::IIdentifier
classes.description: Interface for device identification details, including architecture, chipset, and firmware version.

methods.name: BuildTreeHash
methods.description: Returns a hash representing the build tree of the system.

methods.name: Major
methods.description: Returns the major version number.

methods.name: Minor
methods.description: Returns the minor version number.

methods.name: Patch
methods.description: Returns the patch version number.

methods.name: Updated
methods.description: Notification callback invoked when a subsystem change occurs.

methods.name: Callsign
methods.description: Returns the security subsystem's callsign.

methods.name: PublicIPAddress
methods.description: Returns the public IP address of the device.

methods.name: NetworkType
methods.description: Returns the network type (IPv4, IPv6, or Unknown).

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts network_type enum to string representation.

methods.name: TimeZone
methods.description: Returns the timezone of the device location.

methods.name: Country
methods.description: Returns the country of the device location.

methods.name: Region
methods.description: Returns the region of the device location.

methods.name: City
methods.description: Returns the city of the device location.

methods.name: Latitude
methods.description: Returns the latitude coordinate.

methods.name: Longitude
methods.description: Returns the longitude coordinate.

methods.name: Identifier
methods.description: Fills buffer with device identifier data.

methods.name: Architecture
methods.description: Returns the device architecture string.

methods.name: Chipset
methods.description: Returns the chipset information.

methods.name: FirmwareVersion
methods.description: Returns the firmware version.

methods.name: TimeSync
methods.description: Returns the current time synchronization status.

methods.name: Storage
methods.description: Returns provisioning storage information.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Advances to the next item in the iterator.

methods.name: Previous
methods.description: Moves to the previous item in the iterator.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the iterator to a specific position.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the current iterator position is valid.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Returns the number of items in the iterator.

methods.name: Current
methods.description: Returns the current item in the iterator.
